note: A replay of captured stdout paced by measured wall time, clamped between MIN and MAX seconds per segment; the wall times are pacing data, not benchmarks.

segments.title: The contract: who owns each field, and which writes are the integration's own
Every difference, with the stale side named or the reason no side can be
segments.command: node bin/csr referee --salesforce fixture/salesforce --external fixture/external --contract contract/sync-contract.json

segments.title: One field: the echo of a stale value a timestamp comparison gets backwards
segments.command: node bin/csr explain Contact.Email 003Kd0000000013AAA --salesforce fixture/salesforce --external fixture/external --contract contract/sync-contract.json

segments.title: The same run with a 30-day archive of change events instead of the 72-hour bus
segments.command: node bin/csr referee --salesforce fixture/salesforce --external fixture/external --contract contract/sync-contract.json --window 720h

segments.title: The external side pulled over REST with a client-credentials token, paginated, backing off on 429
segments.command: node bin/csr pull --from http://127.0.0.1:34217 --client-id sf-sync-bridge --client-secret fixture-secret-not-a-secret --contract contract/sync-contract.json --out /tmp/csr-demo-erp --limit 20
